ShortDescription.Value: Unlock all Signature, place multiple Unique buildings, and customize city-wide and local effects to be vanilla or non-stacking bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Realistic Signature Buildings ## :cityscape: Realistic Signature Buildings — Testers Wanted!
**Unlimited buildings without making the economy unrealistic and broken!**
Duplicate Signature buildings stack powerful city-wide bonuses, making CS2's economy too easy. **Now YOU control the bonuses!**
### 1. City-wide bonuses — 3 choices
- **Vanilla Stacking:** every copy contributes normal bonuses. Want super-easy mode? Keep stacking! - **First Copy Only (mod default):** only one copy of each building contributes city-wide bonuses. More Realistic, 5 building copies no longer has 5x stacked bonuses! - **No City Bonuses:** disable Signature city-wide bonuses for a bigger challenge.
### 2. Nearby Local Effects — Separate controls! - Keep neighborhood "aoe" benefits w/out stacking city-wide broken bonuses! - Choose **Vanilla, First-Copy Only, or Off** independent of your city-wide bonus setting.
### 3. More Options - You choose! :white_check_mark: Allow unlimited unique buildings. no need for 3 separate mods just to deal with buildings. :white_check_mark: QoL, Hide mass unlock pop-ups: Stop the Spam when unlocking many Signature buildings at once. Save your click finger! :white_check_mark: Unlock all buildings without meeting normal population, zoning, or progression requirements. I want it NOW! :white_check_mark: See buildings CLEARLY: hide auto Infoview overlays when placing Unique buildings, disables colored ground overlay and black-out of buildings! You can still open infoviews manually if you miss it or disable this toggle [x] (was a player request).
### Compatibility - Compatible with **Anarchy**, including its multiple unique setting. - Avoid installing other mods that have the same unique-placement features, no need for 3-4 mods just for Signature. See Options Status, mod detects if you have duplicate mod installed. - Safe to remove: existing building copies stay, normal vanilla rules return. No Harmony patching, all vanilla.
### Notes
- To read diagnostic results: Options > About > Debug / Logging > Open Log. - Hover over Options rows for explanations.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like (top right), no donations requested, just a like for many days of work. - For feedback, use the GitHub or Discord links on this page. PRs are welcome.
